# Security Direct - Gate Motor, Garage Door & Electric Fence Services

> Security Direct provides professional gate motor repairs, gate motor installations, electric fence repairs, garage door motor services, CCTV installation, and home security alarm services across Alberton and the greater Johannesburg South and East region.

## Core Services

- [Gate Motor Repairs](https://securitydirect.co.za/gate-motor-repair): Emergency diagnostics, PC board repair, rack and pinion replacement, battery replacements, and same-day gate motor repairs.
- [Gate Motor Installation](https://securitydirect.co.za/gate-motor-installation): New sliding and swing gate automation, anti-theft brackets, solar gate options, and certified installations.
- [Centurion Gate Motors](https://securitydirect.co.za/gate-motors/centurion): Authorized installation and repairs for Centurion D5 Evo, D5 Smart, D10 Smart, D20 Smart, and Vantage swing gate motors.
- [Gate Motors Overview](https://securitydirect.co.za/gate-motors): Comprehensive guide to gate motor brands including Centurion, ET Nice, and Gemini.
- [Electric Fence Installation](https://securitydirect.co.za/electric-fence-installation): Certified electric fence installations with COC certificate issuance, bracket installation, and energizer setup.
- [Electric Fence Repair](https://securitydirect.co.za/electric-fence-repair): Rapid fault finding, broken wire repairs, energizer troubleshooting, and siren fault fixes.
- [Garage Door Installation](https://securitydirect.co.za/garage-door-installation): Sectional, roll-up, and tip-up garage door automation and motor installations.
- [Garage Door Repair](https://securitydirect.co.za/garage-door-repair): Spring replacements, cable re-tensioning, track alignment, and garage door motor repairs.
- [CCTV Security Systems](https://securitydirect.co.za/cctv): High-definition IP and analog CCTV camera installations, remote viewing setup, and NVR/DVR maintenance.
- [Alarm System Installation](https://securitydirect.co.za/alarm-system-installation): Wireless and hardwired home & commercial alarm system installations and sensor configuration.
- [Alarm System Repair](https://securitydirect.co.za/alarm-system-repair): False alarm diagnostics, battery replacements, keypad repairs, and beam alignments.
